Package com.epitech.depthdiablo.item

Interface ItemSpec

All Known Implementing Classes:
ItemSpec.AxeSpec, ItemSpec.ExecutionerRingSpec, ItemSpec.FireRingSpec, ItemSpec.FireStaffSpec, ItemSpec.LeatherArmorSpec, ItemSpec.LifeStealRingSpec, ItemSpec.PlainBowSpec, ItemSpec.PotionSpec, ItemSpec.ShieldSpec, ItemSpec.StatRingSpec, ItemSpec.SwordSpec
public sealed interface ItemSpec permits ItemSpec.PotionSpec, ItemSpec.SwordSpec, ItemSpec.LeatherArmorSpec, ItemSpec.FireRingSpec, ItemSpec.AxeSpec, ItemSpec.ShieldSpec, ItemSpec.StatRingSpec, ItemSpec.LifeStealRingSpec, ItemSpec.ExecutionerRingSpec, ItemSpec.PlainBowSpec, ItemSpec.FireStaffSpec
The values of one entry of data/items.json (Q93, Q129), typed by its "class". ItemSpecReader reads them and ItemFactory builds the item; the item's constructor checks the values.

Sealed, so the factory's switch must handle every kind of item.
